params.body:
On the Overview cards and in the review queue, the evidence line read like "20 outright and 16 in part, from 20 sources; 20 unrelated." Two things made the end of it hard to read:

- No count named its noun, so "20 unrelated" floated: 20 what?
- "Unrelated" is the judge's verdict label (Standard: `supports`, `partly`, `unrelated`), passed through as is. It did not say unrelated to what. Under the Standard these are candidate signals a pattern or concept brought along that turned out not to be about the claim.

Now:

- Cards and review queue (`evidence.js`): "20 signals outright and 16 in part, from 20 sources; 20 about something else."
- Opened insight (`InsightReading.jsx`): "...; 20 about something else" in place of "20 judged unrelated", so both places say the same thing.
- The evidence bar's accessible label reads the same words.

e2e: the i-1 mock now has 2 unrelated signals, so the specs pin the new clause on the card, its bar label and the opened insight. The whole suite passes (84), and eslint is clean on the touched files.
params.title: Say what an unrelated signal is in the evidence line
